system.description:
Built on Project FU's Invoker.

FREE BENEFITS
  • Increased maximum HP or MP (choose one).

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise.)

DOWSER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000093]{Invocation} 【Max SL 3】

Action + 5 MP: draw on one of the scene's wellsprings and apply an invocation to a creature you can see. SL1 reaches "blast" invocations, SL2 adds "hex", SL3 all. Scaling: damage +5/+10 at level 20+/40+; HP recovery and MP loss +10/+20.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000094]{Linked Invocation} 【Max SL 3】

When you invoke, spend up to (SL × 10) extra MP; every 10 MP adds one more target you can see.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000095]{Elemental Harmony} 【Max SL 2】

Always communicate with elementals. When your invocation or spell restores HP with an elemental present on the scene, it restores (SL × 5) more.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000096]{Ripples} 【Max SL 5】

After an ally's damage — increased by one or more of your "hex" invocations — costs an enemy HP: free attack against that enemy only, at +(SL) Accuracy. On a hit its damage becomes the ally's type, and all your hexes on the target end once it resolves. If two or more enemies trigger this Skill at the same time, you may perform a free attack against each of them, in whatever order you prefer.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000097]{Wellspring Expansion} 【Max SL 5】

With an arcane, bow, brawling, flail, sword or thrown weapon equipped: "blast" invocations deal (SL) extra damage, and your "hex" invocations grant (5 + SL) extra damage instead of 5.
